journey.name: LC-03 The date picker survives a rotation
journey.description:
Covers NFR-06 for the one piece of editor state that does not live in the ViewModel: whether the date picker is open.
REGRESSION GUARD (issue #8). This journey failed on the build of 2026-09-08. The editor held the picker's visibility in `var picking by remember`, which does not survive a configuration change, so rotating with the picker open closed it and dropped the date the user had highlighted. The form behind it survived, because that state is in the ViewModel - the dialog was the one gap left. It is now rememberSaveable, and rememberDatePickerState was already saveable, so the highlighted date comes back with it.
Preconditions: adb shell settings put system accelerometer_rotation 0 adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0
